_about: The dashboard To-Do feed: a short, layman-readable daily checklist of curation work (for Sam) and engineering/pre-curation work (for Fable, the Claude session), rendered by cpl_todos.js as the 📋 To-Do button on every tab. Refreshed at every Rule-8 checkpoint alongside the session handoff (this file is the handoff distilled for the dashboard). Check-off state lives in each viewer's browser (localStorage) and resets when _as_of changes. Keep it SHORT — ≤ ~12 items; done items are deleted, not checked.
_as_of: 2026-08-05 · SkyPartner — the Noncredit & Learning Partners tab is LIVE with the six modes, a self-refreshing dormant-exhibit worklist, and an ✎ Add insight affordance on every card.
_status: Noncredit/Learning-Partner CPL went from a cold research ask to a live instrument today: a ~1,530-line thinking document, a new COBI tab, narrative cross-references, and a write layer that's applied and working. The headline finding is that 49 statewide exhibits sit published-but-unused across 252 college-slots — the expensive faculty work is already done on all of them, so the near-term play is outreach rather than building more. The four standalone noncredit institutions are at zero in MAP, which is the cheapest fix available. Funding metrics are deliberately parked until the mechanisms are fully mapped. Six items are waiting on Sam's input, and they can now be answered directly in the tab.

items.text: 🤝 NEW TAB — Noncredit & Learning Partners. Start with 'Where this sits today': it opens with the SIX WAYS CPL applies (mirrored courses · certificates and licenses · noncredit certificates · high-school Cx · portfolio · CPL toward a noncredit award), each defined by what the student brings, what it costs, and where it stands — so the team can prioritize college by college. Sections collapse; there are jump links, Expand/Collapse all, and a report generator (Copy · Markdown · Word · Print).

✎ You can now ADD INSIGHT on any card — questions, opportunities, modes, use cases. Needs the team phrase set (same one as Team & RACI). Revising keeps the previous version; nothing is ever deleted and answering never closes an item. When you've added a few, '↑ Promote notes' exports a packet so they can be folded into the register properly.

❓ 6 items are waiting on you (filter: 'Needs Input'). The one that unlocks the most: HOW MANY colleges and high-school partners are on the incumbent articulation system? It sizes the largest-volume lane in the whole analysis and nothing in our repos carries it. Also open: is MAP's high-school role decided or aspirational, landing-page build dates, the CDCR back-catalog, Calbright's FTES (needs Malone), and where the '44 non-CCC dental programs' figure came from.

⭐ THE BIG FINDING: 49 statewide exhibits are published across 252 college-slots with ZERO students served — only 30 of 84 statewide exhibits have ever converted a single unit. CompTIA Linux+ is live at 16 colleges and has never produced an award. The faculty work is DONE on all of these; what's missing is outreach. Cheapest volume available anywhere in CPL. The list is live in the tab and refreshes itself.

⚠ NOCE, San Diego College of Continuing Education, Mt. SAC Noncredit and Calbright appear on ZERO of MAP's 1,987 credential titles — while ~48 entries already name a specific high school. The gap isn't permission or capability; nobody has done the data entry. Highest value-for-effort item in the whole workstream.

🦷 27 California colleges teach dental assisting. Exactly ONE (West LA) awards CPL for the RDA license — converting 214 of 215 eligible units. Rocio's 16 units came from the only college that built the pathway. The other 26 are a named outreach list today, no build required.

🚑 EMS Corps: build the landing page + alumni outreach. East LA IS already in MAP, and the statewide EMT exhibit converts at 75.6% across 28 colleges — so this is OUTREACH, not articulation-building. Keynote slide 20 is already the prototype (6 destination pathways). The page IS the outreach vehicle: one link to 500+ alumni.

📘 Write the mirroring playbook. It's the lead recommendation, the Chancellor already named it statewide practice, and there are two documented instruments (a jointly-agreed summative exam, or a CPL rubric on the course outline) — but a college that wants to do it today has nowhere to look.

QUEUED (Sam's idea): a simple ADMINISTRATOR opt-in button on the college rows (VPAA/VPSS/CEO) — the participation-request qual. Recommended design (full write-up in docs/cpl_funding_handoff.md): don't verify against our stale admin roster — capture the current admin AT opt-in time (name/title/email form → pending cpl_optin row) and let the CO confirm in a review lane (reuse the merge-confirm pattern), then wire it into baselineGate. v2 = a magic-link email to a college-domain address for self-service. Build v1 next.

The Budget reconciliation (the next big engineering step, after the queued opt-in). Fold Implementation Funding in as a Budget sub-view — both tabs are JS-rendered, so it's a nav change plus a segmented control [Sources & Uses | $35M model | $15M Distributions | Report]. The single-source wiring (#949) already landed, so the two tabs agree on their numbers. Then: add/delete/reorder ledger rows, and the budget-vs-actual lane. (The funding-model tweaks + Report memo rework are all done; only #3b — gating the NC $1M — is deferred, low value today.)

🆕 The ESL packaging DRY-RUN is ready to eyeball (kb/esl_package_out/2026-07-15/esl_package_report.md + the visual). It maps all 2,364 ESL courses → Beginning/Intermediate/Advanced + carve-outs. Two things worth your look before it applies: (1) confirm the 22 'Transfer-level ESL' candidates (college-composition courses — no transferable flag in the data, so I held them out rather than fold them); (2) the ~629 no-level courses folded to Beginning as the safe under-claim. Green-light → it applies.

✅ Doctrine now v0.13 — ALL named open forks closed (P-13 honors/variant, P-5 whole-vs-part units, D-8 cross-discipline; #791). ESL dry-run shipped (#792). NEXT on Sam's green-light: run the ESL apply from the committed plan (Rule 9: fresh read, INSERT-only ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, cohort package-esl-s117@bot; re-key the 6 promotions). Wire the letter-rung fix first (A/B/C/D ladders currently default to Beginning). Then the whole-worklist batch-apply (Doctrine Part V step 3).

Carpentry folds still in the ⇒ Merge confirms lane: Rigging + Blueprint Reading-Residential rows + a few key collisions — ✓ Confirm merge (or rename apart) per row. Plus 4 still-ambiguous CTCNC rows (CARP 707/710/713 + Work Experience) that carry TWO credit recs each — pick the right title in-cell.

⚠️ Two errors are still in the Sept-2026 BOG amendment workbook itself — the copy heading to the Board. Its grand total says $74,000,000 but double-counts the $8,959,692 project slice (the real figure is $71,000,000), and its 'Max Award $665,971' is a typo for $665,791 computed over 115 colleges while its average uses 119. Our tab already shows the corrected numbers.
